# Procedure template API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A reusable template that prefills a new procedure.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/proceduretemplate/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `proceduretemplate` (detail, create, update), `proceduretemplates` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [Procedure type](/api/schemas/procedure/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Schema payload:** `coordinates_system` selects a [Coordinates type](/api/schemas/coordinates/); send its fields in `coordinates_details`. `coordinates_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`materialusagetemplate`](/api/modules/materialusagetemplate/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids |
| `type` | one of the [Procedure types](/api/schemas/procedure/) **[required]** |
| `type_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `date_time` | datetime; nullable |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable; nestable |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids; nestable. Licenses authorizing this specific procedure |
| `equipment` | list of [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) ids |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `equipment_setup` | computed |
| `target_regions` | list of [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) ids |
| `target_regions_atlas` | computed |
| `target_regions_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `coordinates_system` | one of the [Coordinates types](/api/schemas/coordinates/) **[required]** |
| `coordinates_details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**. Schema version for type_json field |
| `coordinates_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**. Schema version for coordinates_json field |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `user_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `summary` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `materials` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `stages` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('proceduretemplate', load_all=True)
records = resp['proceduretemplates']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('proceduretemplate', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.proceduretemplates;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('proceduretemplate', data={"name": "Procedure template 1", "type": "Anesthesia", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}, "coordinates_system": "Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface", "coordinates_details": {"...": "the fields of the selected Coordinates type"}})
record = resp.json()['proceduretemplate']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Procedure template 1', 'type', 'Anesthesia', 'details', struct(), 'coordinates_system', 'Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface', 'coordinates_details', struct()), 'proceduretemplate');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.proceduretemplate;
```

## Detail

- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/<id>/`

```

record = out.proceduretemplate;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('proceduretemplate', id='<id>', data={"name": "Procedure template 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Procedure template 1 (renamed)'), 'proceduretemplate', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/proceduretemplate/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('proceduretemplate', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'proceduretemplate');
```
